description: This Java source file is an Android activity demonstrating the use of action bar tabs with nested fragment management and tab interactions.

classes.name: FragmentNestingTabs
classes.description: An Android activity demonstrating tabbed navigation with fragment management.

classes.name: FragmentNestingTabs.TabListener
classes.description: A generic listener class implementing ActionBar.TabListener to manage fragment transactions upon tab interactions.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up the action bar with tabs, and restores state.

methods.name: onSaveInstanceState
methods.description: Saves the current tab selection state.

methods.name: TabListener
methods.description: Manages fragment attachment/detachment in response to tab selection events.

methods.name: onTabSelected
methods.description: Handles the activation of the fragment associated with the selected tab.

methods.name: onTabUnselected
methods.description: Handles the detachment of the fragment when the tab is unselected.

methods.name: onTabReselected
methods.description: Handles re-selection of a tab, providing user feedback via a toast message.
